name: Research Agent
purpose: An AI research agent app: a signed-in user submits a research question, the agent runs a sequence of steps (plan, search, read, verify, synthesize), and every step plus its result is recorded and rendered as a replayable timeline.

entities.name: ResearchStep
relationships: name (plan|search|read|verify|synthesize), status (pending|running|complete|failed), input, output, position, duration_ms

workflows.name: Submit a research question
workflows.description: Signed-in user submits a question; a ResearchRun is created and the agent executes steps in order, recording each one

workflows.name: Watch the timeline live
workflows.description: The run page shows steps appearing in real time with status and result as the agent works

workflows.name: Review past runs
workflows.description: User lists their past runs and opens any completed or failed run to see its full recorded timeline

workflows.name: Swap in a real provider
workflows.description: Operator sets OPENAI_API_KEY (and optional base URL/model) env vars; the adapter switches from the canned demo provider to the real provider with no code change

seed_demo: A completed sample research run ("How does a pulsar keep its spin for billions of years?") with all five steps populated so the timeline renders fully on first load, plus a demo user.
